design.mixed: Existing exact control: interleaved expert/attention task IDs in one front launch, then the unchanged down/join launch.
design.blocked: Same two launches and all math; expert task IDs first, attention task IDs second within the front launch. Does NOT enforce branch serialization.
design.separate: Same expert/activation and attention tile functions in separate front launches, then the unchanged down/join launch. Three launches total.
design.comparison_limit: Separate-vs-mixed changes launch count and grid/resource scheduling together. It does not isolate launch overhead from simultaneous execution or register-resource effects.
